name: Autumn Diary
source:
This is a story about a guy and a girl living in a city that has not seen sunlight for a long time. He is a student and lives alone. She lives with her mother and doesn't leave her apartment because of agoraphobia. Everything changed in their lives when they saw each other in the windows of their houses. But in what direction will these changes lead?
